user.title: Connect to Argus
user.description: Create a token in Argus under Account → API tokens. Tokens only read, so Home Assistant cannot change anything in Argus.

data_description.url: The address you open Argus at in your browser.
data_description.api_token: Starts with argus_at_. Home Assistant sees the systems its owner sees.

reauth_confirm.title: New Argus token
reauth_confirm.description: Argus no longer accepts the token for {url}; it may have been revoked. Create a new one under Account → API tokens.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Argus at that address.
error.invalid_auth: Argus refused the token. Check it, and that Argus is version 0.9.0 or later.
error.invalid_token_format: API tokens start with argus_at_. Enrollment tokens (argus_et_) are for agents.
error.invalid_url: Enter the full address, starting with https:// or http://.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong; the Home Assistant log has the details.

abort.already_configured: This Argus server is already set up with this account.
abort.wrong_account: That token belongs to a different Argus account. Use one from the same account.

data_description.scan_interval: Agents report every 15 seconds by default.
